text: 中国央行：2026年8月，政府债券净融资10097.3亿元，同比减少3574.6亿元；企业债券净融资2712.5亿元，同比增加1374.0亿元。2026年8月末，债券市场托管余额209.0万亿元。
text_en: PBOC: In August 2026, net government bond financing was 1,009.73 billion yuan, a year-on-year decrease of 357.46 billion yuan; net corporate bond financing was 271.25 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 137.40 billion yuan. At the end of August 2026, the custodial balance of the bond market was 209.0 trillion yuan.
